feeds.title: Minnesota Monthly
feeds.description: Minnesota Monthly is a publication of Greenspring Media, a multi-platform communications company specializing in the creation and distribution of lifestyle content that connects readers and viewers to advertisers and marketing partners. Minnesota Monthly embodies the spirit of the state, celebrating the best arts, entertainment, food, and culture in Minneapolis, St. Paul, and greater MN.

feeds.title: Peyton's Momma
feeds.description: Shanna is a single mom living in the suburbs of the Twin Cities raising an elementary age daughter. Shanna blogs about family/lifestyle/elementary age children topics. She likes to share tips and tricks she has discovered to help make her life run smoother.

feeds.title: The Styled Press
feeds.description: A Minneapolis Fashion, Beauty & Lifestyle Blog by Taylor Brown. She shares her personal style, beauty tips, lifestyle happenings, and whatever else inspires her.

feeds.title: Real Housewives of Minnesota
feeds.description: Real Housewives of Minnesota is a lifestyle blog by Sarah, a mom from Minnesota. She writes about family life, recipes, fitness tips, parenting, and local adventures. Her posts are simple, friendly, and feel like advice from a friend. It's all about sharing real-life experiences and helpful ideas for busy moms.

feeds.title: MinneMama Adventures
feeds.description: A blog about discovering family friendly activities and everyday excursions for Minnesota parents and their minis. Authored by Nicki, who is an avid adventurer and mother of three.

feeds.title: Thrifty Minnesota
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Chrysa, and I'm here along with my friends Kristi and Laura to share fun and thrifty ways for you and your family to enjoy all the awesome things Minnesota has to offer!

feeds.title: Fit Foodie Finds
feeds.description: Fit Foodie Finds is a blog devoted to healthy living where I (Lee) attempt to find balance in my every day life. I love food and I love fitness. FFF is not only a place where I share delicious, healthy recipes and fun workouts but a place where I share my experiences too.

feeds.title: Paisley + Sparrow
feeds.description: I'm Jen!I'm a crazy plant lady and mom of 3 who loves cookie dough, removable wallpaper + balloon garlands.This blog is a place to help you find joy in your life, style + home. I'm glad you're here!

feeds.title: North MN Outdoors
feeds.description: This blog is to learn something new. To share pictures and observations about nature near Hackensack, Walker, and Akeley Minnesota. To record seasonal changes throughout the spring, summer, and fall in this lake region.

feeds.title: Minnesota Farm Living
feeds.description: My name is Wanda Patsche. My blog is like looking through the window to my life. I open the curtains and share my perspective and truth about agriculture and other important life topics. You will see pictures of my family, my farm, my travel adventures, and beautiful rural Minnesota farm living. In other words. my life.

feeds.title: Carpediem With Jasmine Blog
feeds.description: Lifestyle blog from Jasmine. I'm a daughter, a southern belle, foodie, world traveler, adventure seeker, and faith walker. I started this blog in 2007.

feeds.title: Minnesota Yogini
feeds.description: Free Spirited, Inspired, Gymnast Turned Yogi. Travel, Fitness and Lifestyle Blogger, SAHM, Yoga Teacher & Outdoor Enthusiast. Here, I am sharing stories and ideas from my own travels and adventures, as well as tips, lessons learned, and inspiration in hopes to inspire you to live your fullest life, with a healthy body, and a positive mind.

feeds.title: Pickles Travel
feeds.description: I'm Greta. A Midwestern pickle-eating, travel-loving, Spanish-speaking, Photographer who loves the rural life- preserving its food, stories, and barns! You'll get a lot of travel stories here because I love to share the ever-changing world we live in.

feeds.title: The Wanderlust Rose
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Emily Rose! I'm currently living out of my suitcase full time and working around the world. Follow along on the adventure, as I cross each experience off my bucket list. On my site, you can find the travel jobs I've worked and where you can apply, how to travel on a budget, packing guides.

feeds.title: Look about Lindsey
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Lindsey, a born and raised Minnesota blogger who lives in Minneapolis. I spend my free time exploring everything from my North Loop neighborhood to destinations overseas and this is where you can find all the details! I hope my experiences inspire you to find the hidden gems in your small town or book that next flight all while on a budget and working full time!

feeds.title: Minnesota Parent
feeds.description: Minnesota Parent is the Twin Cities' premier parenting publication. They are your go-to guide for ideas and inspiration, helpful parenting resources, and family-friendly events happening right here in Minnesota! Minnesota Parent has been your parenting partner for over 35 years. They are your resource for all things parenting-related.

feeds.title: Bert Anderson
feeds.description: Welcome! Kick up your feet, rest your pretty little mama head, and let's celebrate being moms together. In case you're new here, allow me to introduce myself. I'm Bert. That's me. And yes, I'm a mom too.

feeds.title: Kelly Zugay Blog
feeds.description: A Saint Paul, Minnesota-based lifestyle, decor, and travel blog by Kelly Zugay. I'm Kelly.Here, you'll discover bits and pieces of our everyday lives, home decorating, and our travels.
